userStories.title: The story-review prompt states the full suite's result
userStories.description:
**Goal** — State the full suite's recorded result alongside the other story gates in the initial story-review prompt.

**Motivation** — A stated suite result removes the reason to write them. Here, 'them' means cannot-verify lines about the suite running later.

**Approach** — The prompt block becomes:

```
## What nax already checked
nax ran these gates on this story before your review: lint <s>, typecheck <s>, scoped tests <s>, full suite <s>.
Do not list these gates in "cannotVerify": their results are stated here. Once every story is done nax runs the repository gates; nax records whether they ran and what they returned, so do not list the repository gates in "cannotVerify" either.
If you have a shell tool, run this story's own test files with one scoped test command before you give the spec verdict.<e2e>
```

where each `<s>` is the recorded state or `not run`. When the full suite state is `red`, one more line follows the gates line: `The full suite is red; nax already records its failures as open findings, so do not repeat them as findings.`
The e2e sentence and `CANNOT_VERIFY_RULE` are unchanged.

`naxCheckedBlock` names the full suite's recorded state next to lint, typecheck and scoped tests, drops the "after your review nax runs the full test suite" wording, keeps the repository-gates rule, and adds the red-suite line.

**Scope** — In: packages/nax/src/prompts/builders/workflow-story-review-builder.ts and its existing prompt tests. Replace the tests "story review says which gates run after it (AC-6)" and "story review qualifies the suite as conditional and leaves unreached gates to nax's record (F1)" with assertions on the gates line naming full suite and the repository-gates sentence. The `not.toContain("if nax never reached one")` assertion stays. Out: suite ordering and merged-state forwarding (US-002), the last-pass exception (US-003), and unreviewed close metadata (US-004). The re-review prompt (`buildWorkflowReReviewPrompt`) is not given gate states. `isGateTimingItem` and `ledgerCannotVerify` are not changed. The repository gates that run after every story is done keep their place and behaviour.

**Interface** — Keep `naxCheckedBlock(gates, e2eGate)` and `buildWorkflowStoryReviewPrompt`'s existing input contract; `WorkflowStoryGateStates` already includes `"full-suite"`. The existing TypeScript declaration is:
```typescript
export type WorkflowStoryGateStates = Readonly<
  Partial<Record<"lint" | "typecheck" | "scoped" | "full-suite", "green" | "red" | "skipped">>
>;
```
No new required prompt argument is introduced; absent gate states continue to render `not run`. Write failing prompt assertions before implementing the block change.

userStories.title: The story loop runs the full suite before the review
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Run the suite before report check and review on every pass whose story gates are green, short-circuiting every red-suite pass in this intermediate story.

**Motivation** — Code a fix round writes to turn a red suite green is never reviewed today: the review already ran, nothing is in `reviewOpen`, so no re-review runs.

**Approach** — Implement the suite-first algorithm below; the last-pass exception is deliberately deferred to US-003.

1. `s.suiteThisIteration = false`; run `env.steps.gates()`. Red gates return the gate findings followed by `s.reviewOpen`, exactly as today; the suite, report check and review do not run in that pass.
2. Set phase `suite`; `s.suite = await env.steps.fullSuite()`; `s.suiteThisIteration = true`. When `s.suite.red`, the suite findings are assigned ids (`s.assign(s.suite.findings)`) here, before any review finding of this pass.

A red suite returns its findings followed by `s.reviewOpen` without running the report check or the review; in this story that holds on every pass, the last one included (US-003 adds the last-pass exception). The existing `passExit` routing sends that open list to a fix only while rounds remain; at the cap it sends the list to residual adjudication, not to another fix turn.

For that early return, retain the design's state-preservation rule: The report check and the review do not run, and `s.fixBase` is left as it is, so the next re-review diffs from the head recorded before the first fix of the open review findings.

For a non-red suite, continue with the remaining steps (the final-pass-red clause is intentionally excluded until US-003):
4. Otherwise: `runReportCheck`, set phase `review` or `rereview`, then `review()`.
5. Return the suite findings (empty when green or skipped) followed by `s.reviewOpen`.

`review()` passes the merged gate states, `{ ...s.gates?.states, ...s.suite?.states }`, as the second argument of `env.steps.storyReview`. `reReview` is unchanged.

`residualStep` keeps its guard `!s.gates?.red && !s.suiteThisIteration`. With the suite in every pass whose gates are green, the residual runs the suite only when the last pass ended on red gates, and then the guard skips it, so in practice the residual no longer runs the suite. Its code does not change.

The cost: the suite now runs on every pass whose gates are green, re-review passes included, so a story the review sends back pays one extra suite run per fix round. A clean story runs the suite once, as today.

**Scope** — In: evaluate/review ordering and state forwarding in packages/nax/src/workflow/story-steps.ts; new loop scenarios in packages/nax/test/unit/workflow/story-loop-suite-first.test.ts; existing call-order/state/count assertions and equivalence traces; step-order comments above evaluate, evaluateStep and residualStep. Update packages/nax/README.md's story line to `story: implement → gates → full suite → story review → fix rounds → residual ruling`; update repository-root docs/guides/regression-gate.md to say the workflow suite runs before the story review in every pass whose gates are green. Keep the binding workdir packages/nax for this explicitly required documentation edit. Out: the red-final-pass exception and residual review evidence (US-003), and computed closing unreviewed metadata (US-004). Do not rework the prompt block owned by US-001. The repository gates that run after every story is done keep their place and behaviour. The re-review prompt (`buildWorkflowReReviewPrompt`) is not given gate states. `residualStep` code is not changed; its suite branch stays for a residual entered with `suiteThisIteration` false. Pipeline mode is frozen and not changed. A suite result from an earlier pass is not cleared when a later pass stops on red gates; `deriveEndState` and the residual's `redGates` may still name `full-suite` from that earlier pass, as they can today.

**Interface** — Keep existing contracts read-only: `StoryLoopSteps.fullSuite(): Promise<GateRunResult>` and `StoryLoopSteps.storyReview(concerns, gates?)`; `runReportCheck(env, state, runTurn): Promise<boolean>`. `fullSuite()` throws: Not caught by the loop, as today: the error escapes `runStoryLoop`. Suite skipped (gate disabled): Treated as not red: review runs; the prompt states `full suite skipped`. The prompt/state seam enters at runStoryLoop and asserts what storyReview received, not just builder output. Use makeStoryLoopHarness, whose script.suite queues fullSuite results (exhaustion defaults green), reviewGates captures review arguments, and updates captures sink patches.

Write failing behavioral cases first. In story-loop-equivalence.test.ts, change the recorded call list from `["implement", "answerQuestion", "implement", "costExceeded", "gates", "storyReview", "fullSuite"]` to `["implement", "answerQuestion", "implement", "costExceeded", "gates", "fullSuite", "storyReview"]`; move the review-arguments assertion to `calls[6]?.args`, equal to `[[], { ...GREEN.states, ...SUITE_GREEN.states }]`. Preserve call/return pairing. In story-loop.test.ts, add `"full-suite": "green"` to the gate-context expectation and change the maxFixRounds:1 residual suite count from 1 to 2, with a name saying the suite ran in the last pass. Regenerate order/state traces for clean, full-suite-red, review-fail-one-round, rereview-new-finding, residual-rulings, fresh-after-warm-cap, needs-context-answered, red-gates-then-green, review-not-ran, resume-mid-fix and no-work-restart. From packages/nax use `NAX_UPDATE_WORKFLOW_GOLDEN=1 bun test test/unit/workflow/story-loop-equivalence.test.ts`, then `bun x biome format --write test/fixtures/workflow-equivalence/story/`. Do not hand-reorder trace events or add the final-pass exception ahead of US-003.

userStories.title: On the last pass a red suite still goes to the review
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Allow a red suite on the final evaluate pass to reach report check and review/re-review, so residual adjudication sees review findings even when the story ends red.

**Motivation** — A plain reorder would skip the review on every such story. This refers to repositories whose baseline is already red.

**Approach** — Replace US-002's unconditional red-suite return with the final-pass-aware algorithm. One pass of `evaluate()`, in order:

1. `s.suiteThisIteration = false`; run `env.steps.gates()`. Red gates return the gate findings followed by `s.reviewOpen`, exactly as today; the suite, report check and review do not run in that pass.
2. Set phase `suite`; `s.suite = await env.steps.fullSuite()`; `s.suiteThisIteration = true`. When `s.suite.red`, the suite findings are assigned ids (`s.assign(s.suite.findings)`) here, before any review finding of this pass.
3. Last pass means `s.round >= env.maxFixRounds`. When the suite is red and this is not the last pass, return the suite findings followed by `s.reviewOpen`. The report check and the review do not run, and `s.fixBase` is left as it is, so the next re-review diffs from the head recorded before the first fix of the open review findings.
4. Otherwise (suite green, skipped, or red on the last pass): `runReportCheck`, set phase `review` or `rereview`, then `review()`.
5. Return the suite findings (empty when green or skipped) followed by `s.reviewOpen`.

`review()` passes the merged gate states, `{ ...s.gates?.states, ...s.suite?.states }`, as the second argument of `env.steps.storyReview`. `reReview` is unchanged.

When the suite is red and `s.round >= env.maxFixRounds`, `evaluate()` runs the report check and the review (or re-review) anyway, and returns the suite findings followed by the review's open findings, so the residual adjudicates the review findings of a story that ends red.

Failure handling: Suite red on the last pass: Report check and review run; open = suite findings, then review findings; the residual adjudicates the non-gate items; end state `complete-gate-open`.

**Scope** — In: the red-suite condition in story-steps.ts, extension of the suite-first loop cases created by US-002, and regeneration of the existing full-suite-red equivalence fixture for the final-pass review call. Preserve suite-before-review ordering, merged gate states, suite-first finding IDs, maxFixRounds accounting, and the original fixBase across a skipped middle re-review. The suite-first foundation and prompt block are already provided by US-002/US-001. Out: closing unreviewed computation/persistence (US-004). `deriveEndState` and the end states are unchanged; a red suite still ends a story `complete-gate-open`. `residualStep` code is not changed; its suite branch stays for a residual entered with `suiteThisIteration` false. The full suite still blocks the review on failures that were already present in the baseline; making only new failures block is a separate change. The re-review prompt (`buildWorkflowReReviewPrompt`) is not given gate states.

**Interface** — Keep `StoryLoopSteps.fullSuite(): Promise<GateRunResult>` and `StoryLoopSteps.storyReview(concerns, gates?)` unchanged. Keep reReview's existing round/findings/fixBase contract. All seam cases enter at runStoryLoop; capture advisor.ruleResidual requests using makeStoryLoopAdvisor and observe sink updates for the final open findings. With two red suite passes, assign F1 on pass one, F2 to the final suite finding, and F3 to the first review's new spec finding. With zero allowed fix rounds, round zero is already the last pass, so review still runs without a fix turn.

Write failing final-pass scenarios in packages/nax/test/unit/workflow/story-loop-suite-first.test.ts before changing the condition. One golden reaches the last pass with a red suite: story-loop-equivalence.test.ts:535-540 (full-suite-red) uses maxFixRounds:1 with an always-red suite. Regenerate its existing full-suite-red.json trace for the newly permitted final-pass storyReview call and merged red suite state, preserving end state/reason and fix-turn count. Use the existing NAX_UPDATE_WORKFLOW_GOLDEN command and Biome formatting documented in that test. This is a necessary update to an existing fixture, not a new story or additional functional requirement.

userStories.title: A story that was never reviewed closes as unreviewed
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Make every story that never reached a review close with unreviewed:true consistently in its outcome, persisted record, and ledger end line.

**Motivation** — A story that closes having never reached a review (gates red to the cap, a no-work close) reports `unreviewed: false`.

**Approach** — `closeStep` computes `unreviewed = s.unreviewed || !s.reviewed` and passes it to `closeLoop`, which writes it to the record in its closing `env.sink.update` (alongside `state`, `reason`, `phase: "closed"`, ...) and uses it for the end line and the returned outcome. This covers the `closeAs` no-work close too. The flag is display-only: besides the story summary and the PR body table, `storyNote` (`packages/nax/src/workflow/feature-steps.ts`) appends `unreviewed` to the story's line in the branch-review facts, so cost-limit, gates-red-to-the-cap and no-work stories now carry that note to the branch reviewer. Nothing gates behaviour on it.

Failure handling: Story never reviewed (gates red to the cap, no-work close, cost limit before the first review): `unreviewed: true` in the outcome, the closing record update and the end line.

**Scope** — In: closeStep/closeLoop in packages/nax/src/workflow/story-steps.ts; new close cases in packages/nax/test/unit/workflow/story-loop-unreviewed.test.ts; the existing story-graph closeAs expectation; regeneration of closing record updates and affected outcomes/end lines. Read feature-record.ts/fromRecord and ledger.ts/ledgerText.end as integration context, without changing their existing consuming behavior. Preserve the existing single closing update, state/reason selection including closeAs, timestamps, ruling/flagged counts, rounds and mirror:false. Keep skipped/unparseable-review behavior: a skipped attempted review sets s.unreviewed and remains complete with unreviewed:true. Out: suite-first evaluation and final-pass review scheduling (US-002/US-003), prompt wording (US-001), new behavior gates based on unreviewed, and backfilling already closed historical records. `deriveEndState` and the end states are unchanged; a red suite still ends a story `complete-gate-open`.

**Interface** — `closeStep` / `closeLoop` in `story-steps.ts`: Baseline: `unreviewed` is `s.unreviewed`; the closing update does not write `unreviewed`. Target: `unreviewed = s.unreviewed || !s.reviewed`, written in the closing update. No public type is added: StoryLoopOutcome and WorkflowStoryRecord already carry a boolean unreviewed. The graph's close node still produces only outcome; pass the resolved flag into the private closing helper without changing graph topology. A successful review means reviewed:true and unreviewed:false; an attempted unparseable review means reviewed:true and unreviewed:true; a never-attempted review means reviewed:false and therefore must close unreviewed:true.

Write failing cases through runStoryLoop using makeStoryLoopHarness, including red lint at both passes, three no-work implementer turns, clean review, cost stop before review, and review returning ran:false for an unparseable reply. Follow the no-work setup in story-loop-no-work.test.ts. Update story-graph.test.ts's "AC-39/AC-40: closeAs decides the outcome, and the record is closed once through the sink" expected outcome from unreviewed:false to true; preserve the single closing update and existing toMatchObject fields. Regenerate all twelve existing story equivalence goldens: clean, full-suite-red, review-fail-one-round, rereview-new-finding, residual-rulings, fresh-after-warm-cap, needs-context-answered, red-gates-then-green, review-not-ran, resume-mid-fix, cost-exceeded and no-work-restart. Every closing update gains unreviewed, false for successfully reviewed stories and true otherwise. The cost-exceeded outcome becomes unreviewed:true and its end line gains `, unreviewed`; no-work-restart is reviewed after its successful restart and closes unreviewed:false. Use `NAX_UPDATE_WORKFLOW_GOLDEN=1 bun test test/unit/workflow/story-loop-equivalence.test.ts` from packages/nax and then Biome-format the fixture directory.

analysis:
Goal and scope: close #2678 by changing only workflow-mode story evaluation to gates → full suite → report check → review, withholding review on a red suite while fixes remain but reviewing red code on the final pass. Record stories that never reached review as unreviewed. This is an enhancement of the existing Bun/TypeScript workflow, not a new subsystem. Exactly four sequential stories are required: US-001 prompt, US-002 suite-first evaluation with unconditional red-suite short-circuit as an intermediate state, US-003 final-pass exception, US-004 closing metadata. All have workdir packages/nax as mandated, including US-002's specifically required repository-root documentation edit. Existing draft content is superseded; final-pass criteria must remain in US-003 rather than being folded into US-002. Navigation used direct reads and text searches because the codebase-memory MCP tools were unavailable. No implementation or validation command was run during PRD generation.

Architecture and contracts: packages/nax/src/workflow/story-loop.ts:35 defines injected StoryLoopSteps, including fullSuite(): Promise<GateRunResult>, storyReview(concerns, gates?), reReview(round, findings, fixBase), head(), and costExceeded(). Its runStoryLoop entry at :154 invokes the step graph without catching step errors. packages/nax/src/workflow/story-graph.ts:18 defines implement/evaluate/fix/residual/close nodes; evaluate already produces suite, suiteThisIteration, reviewOpen, fixBase, reviewed and unreviewed. Its cost-stop rule at :85 checks evaluate/fix boundaries, preserving the initial implement turn and stopping before a first review when cost is already exceeded. No graph topology or new state fields are needed. packages/nax/src/workflow/types.ts:24-34 already declares GateState, GateRunResult, WorkflowEndState and the suite phase; WorkflowStoryRecord at :53 already has reviewed and unreviewed, so no persisted schema/version migration is required. Read docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md before implementation; use existing dependency seams and Bun test helpers rather than module mocks or new external dependencies.

US-001 source and consumers: packages/nax/src/prompts/builders/workflow-story-review-builder.ts:10 already includes full-suite in WorkflowStoryGateStates. However, naxCheckedBlock at :15 only renders lint/typecheck/scoped, and :24 says the suite runs later. Extend the existing state formatter and block, add the conditional red-suite sentence directly after the gates line, preserve the e2e sentence at :19 and CANNOT_VERIFY_RULE at :29, and keep all other prompt content unchanged. The optional gates input at :37 and default {} at :52 preserve direct callers: omitted states render not run. The builder/type are exported by packages/nax/src/prompts/index.ts:137-142 and consumed by packages/nax/src/workflow/story-review.ts:78-95, whose runStoryReview already forwards gates into the prompt. packages/nax/src/workflow/stage-env.ts:119-126 already wires fullSuite to runWorkflowSuiteGate and forwards storyReview's second argument to runStoryReview, so neither adapter nor operation wiring needs changing. Existing prompt tests are in packages/nax/test/unit/prompts/workflow-builders.test.ts:195-268. Replace obsolete expectations at :221 and :230, retaining not.toContain("if nax never reached one") and the existing scoped-command/cannotVerify regression assertions.

US-002/US-003 implementation: packages/nax/src/workflow/story-steps.ts:281 currently resets suiteThisIteration, runs gates, report check, and review, returns early for reviewOpen, then runs the suite. Move the suite phase/call before report check and review on every non-red-gates pass, including re-review passes. Keep the red-gates return unchanged. Assign red-suite draft IDs immediately after the suite result, before this pass's review assigns IDs; reuse those assigned findings when returning suite findings followed by reviewOpen. The assign method at :89 advances F identifiers. review at :220 currently passes only s.gates?.states; pass { ...s.gates?.states, ...s.suite?.states } to initial storyReview, with suite states taking precedence, and leave reReview's interface and behavior unchanged. evaluateStep at :359 appends pending session findings after evaluate's findings and persists openFindings/fixBase/reviewed/nextFindingId; preserve that ordering and persistence. fixStep at :406 increments the round and records head only when review findings are open and fixBase is undefined. Red-suite short-circuits must not call review or clear fixBase, so an existing review cycle continues to diff from the head before its first fix even across multiple red-suite passes. US-002 implements a red-suite return on every pass, including the cap; US-003 narrows it to s.suite.red && s.round < env.maxFixRounds. Final-pass detection is >=, including maxFixRounds: 0 and resumed rounds already at/past the cap. US-003 must run runReportCheck and review/re-review on a red final pass without creating an extra fix round or changing end-state derivation.

Report, suite and residual seams: packages/nax/src/workflow/report-check.ts:75 exposes runReportCheck(env, state, runTurn): Promise<boolean>; it spends at most one report turn and retains its existing cost/fail-open rules. Only its placement changes; red suites before the cap must not even reach the check. Its behavior is also covered by packages/nax/test/unit/workflow/report-check.test.ts. packages/nax/src/workflow/story-steps.ts:392-403 keeps residualStep's executable code unchanged: !s.gates?.red && !s.suiteThisIteration guards the fallback suite; ordinary green-gates evaluate passes now already ran it, while red-gates passes still skip it. Residual items exclude gates, while redGateNames merges gate and suite states; packages/nax/src/workflow/adjudicate.ts:8 then forwards review findings and redGates to advisor.ruleResidual. packages/nax/src/workflow/close.ts:9 remains authoritative: red suites yield complete-gate-open with reason red: full-suite regardless of review findings/rulings. Do not clear an earlier suite result when a later pass stops on red gates. Real suite failures are intentionally not reclassified: packages/nax/src/operations/full-suite-gate.ts:414-427 labels baseline attribution but still returns status failed with all findings, and packages/nax/src/workflow/gates.ts:26-27,142-158 maps failed/error/timeout/inconclusive to red and disabled gates to skipped. A thrown injected fullSuite error must still escape runStoryLoop with its identity unchanged; do not introduce catches in evaluate.

US-004 metadata and consumers: initialStoryState in packages/nax/src/workflow/story-steps.ts:110-137 restores reviewed/unreviewed from resume or defaults both false. review at :220-230 sets reviewed true even when an attempted review returns ran:false, and additionally sets unreviewed true for that skipped attempt. Therefore !reviewed alone is insufficient: closeStep at :445 must compute s.unreviewed || !s.reviewed, including closeAs no-work exits, and pass that resolved value to closeLoop at :305. closeLoop must include it in its single phase:closed update and use the same value for ledgerText.end and the returned StoryLoopOutcome. Preserve state/reason/rulings/flagged/endedAt and mirror:false. packages/nax/src/workflow/ledger.ts:27 already formats the end line; changing that formatter is unnecessary. packages/nax/src/workflow/feature-record.ts:101-113 copies record.unreviewed into StorySummary, packages/nax/src/workflow/pr-body.ts:77 displays it in the PR story table, and packages/nax/src/workflow/feature-steps.ts:70-79 adds unreviewed to branch-review story facts. These are read-only integration consumers: the flag is display-only and must not gate execution, adjudication, publishing, or story state selection. Existing historical closed records are not backfilled; new close writes make resumed/in-progress and new stories accurate using the existing record shape.

US-004 adds unreviewed to closing updates in those eleven plus cost-exceeded; cost-exceeded's outcome/end line also change. packages/nax/test/unit/workflow/story-graph.test.ts:250-269 must expect unreviewed:true for closeAs from initial unreviewed state, preserving its single-close-write assertion. packages/nax/test/unit/workflow/story-loop-no-work.test.ts:179-222 shows how three no-status/no-work turns exercise closeAs without gates/review.

Verified spec discrepancy: the statement that no golden reaches a last pass with a red suite is false in the current checkout. packages/nax/test/unit/workflow/story-loop-equivalence.test.ts:535-540 explicitly runs full-suite-red with maxFixRounds:1 and an always-red fullSuite. Consequently the intermediate US-002 trace skips review on both red passes, and US-003 moves the initial review onto the second, red final pass; full-suite-red.json must be regenerated again in US-003. This is maintenance of the existing golden, not an additional story or changed behavior requirement. Follow authoritative ACs rather than preserving that inaccurate no-golden-change note.

Documentation, risks and rollout: update step-order comments above evaluate/evaluateStep/residualStep, packages/nax/README.md:67 to story: implement → gates → full suite → story review → fix rounds → residual ruling, and docs/guides/regression-gate.md:10 to describe the workflow suite before review on every pass whose gates are green, without changing the pipeline guide's pipeline behavior. Principal risks are off-by-one cap detection, assigning suite IDs after review IDs, losing/replacing the original fixBase across a red-suite pass, spending a report/review turn prematurely, duplicating a residual suite run, misleading display flags on no-work/cost stops, and accidentally changing pipeline/repository gate semantics. Baseline-red repos intentionally spend their available fix rounds before one final review; review-requested fixes now incur another suite run per eligible pass, while a clean story still runs the suite once. No package/dependency/config/schema/public-signature migration is needed. Roll out in dependency order, use focused bun:test scenarios and deliberate trace regeneration as part of implementation, and leave normal pipeline quality gates to the execution system; never use bare bun test or run sandboxed coverage.

The spec's failure-table never-reviewed row additionally supplies US-004 AC13-15 for cost/no-work closing-record/end-line propagation; these are explicit failure-handling requirements, not invented behavior.

Failure-table coverage is complete: red suite with rounds left → US-002 AC4-5/9-11; red suite on the last pass → US-003 AC1-7; skipped suite → US-001 AC3 and US-002 AC15-16; thrown fullSuite → US-002 AC17-18; never-reviewed gates/no-work/cost exits → US-004 AC1-6/9-10/13-15. Each story has a negative path. Regression anchors remain: US-001's still-retained e2e rule, US-002's unchanged red-gates short-circuit and thrown-error identity, US-003's unchanged red-suite end state, and US-004's still-complete unparseable review. All quoted prompt text, including already-recorded failures, is retained. No deprecated grep/file/verbatim AC tags occur.

Audit corrections: replaced ambiguous green-review language with the actual ran:true/StoryReviewVerdict contract and made clean-story criteria independently specify their setup; made review gate states explicitly the second argument; made residual checks explicitly observe advisor.ruleResidual request.items/redGates; expressed unparseable review at the loop seam as ran:false with why:unparseable reply rather than pretending the step returns raw text. Fresh-story/cost-check conditions disambiguate resume and no-work exits without changing the spec's cases. Corrected US-002's misleading implication that a capped red pass starts another fix: existing passExit routes it to residual instead. Explicitly included US-003's required existing-golden refresh in its In scope.

All eight feature-level out-of-scope items remain verbatim, with nearby repository-gate/re-review-prompt boundaries echoed in story scopes; none became an AC. Context selection remains aligned: US-001 includes both specified files, US-002 uses the five most critical of its six recommendations, US-003 includes every specified file plus the existing equivalence test, and US-004 includes all four specified files plus the existing graph regression. US-003's suite-first test context is an upstream US-002 output, not a file US-003 creates. Only US-002 and US-004 create files, each listed solely in expectedFiles. Medium/tdd-simple remains the lightest realistic routing for bounded source-and-test edits using existing seams; no new integration or security contract justifies a heavier strategy.
